correctness.rationale: For all n>=5, the Alexander dual has 3n tetrahedra, 16n triangles, all pairs and no 5-faces. The explicit 9n valid elementary collapses leave n triangular-prism boundaries glued cyclically along disks plus isolated extra edges, hence an integral wedge of n two-spheres and binomial(3n,2)-15n+1 circles. Integral combinatorial Alexander duality gives the exact two free homology groups. The standalone program checks all face sets and elementary pairs and independent F2 homology for n=5..10, which corroborates but does not prove arbitrary n.

value.rationale: The short triangle-factor boundary of a natural periodic Cartesian graph family was excluded from existing toroidal three-cut formulas. It changes the dual from torus topology to an n-fold two-sphere wedge, giving a uniform complete torsion-free integral homology formula and nonshellability for all n>=5. This is motivated structural classification rather than isolated arithmetic.
